def execute_command(image) -> List[ImagePatch]:
    image_patch = ImagePatch(image)
    building_patches = image_patch.find("small building with a blue roof")
    if not building_patches:
        return image_patch
    
    building_patch = building_patches[0]
    building_left = building_patch.left
    building_right = building_patch.right
    building_top = building_patch.upper
    building_bottom = building_patch.lower
    
    pedestrian_patches = image_patch.find("pedestrian")
    near_pedestrians = []
    
    for pedestrian in pedestrian_patches:
        pedestrian_center_x = (pedestrian.left + pedestrian.right) / 2
        pedestrian_center_y = (pedestrian.upper + pedestrian.lower) / 2
        
        if (building_left <= pedestrian_center_x <= building_right) and \
           (building_top <= pedestrian_center_y <= building_bottom):
            near_pedestrians.append(pedestrian)
    
    return near_pedestrians
